name: Kebra
long_description:
Field technicians are bad at documenting their jobs, which paralyzes the back office. Kebra ends that.

We capture what happens in the field and collect the exact job details the back office needs. Before the truck leaves the driveway, Kebra turns every job into complete notes, filed warranty claims, parts orders, and follow-up sales opportunities.

Over time, every job feeds your Company Brain, so your best technicians’ expertise never leaves the company.
one_liner: Field Service Companies that run themselves
